question: The World Games 2022 was held in _______ city of the country, United States of America.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Birmingham.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 2, Birmingham, as it was announced as the host city for the World Games 2022 by the International World Games Association (IWGA) in January 2015.**
 
• The World Games is a multi-sport event held **every four years**, featuring sports that are not part of the Olympic Games.
 
• The event has been delayed due to the coronavirus outbreak.
 
• With the announcement of The Game's shift to July 7-17, 2022, organizers have decided that the international multi-sport event will officially become ‘The World Games 2022'.
 
• It is recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and is considered the largest international event next to the Olympics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **New Orleans** is a city in Louisiana, famous for its music, cuisine, and Mardi Gras celebrations. It has hosted several major sporting events, including the Super Bowl and the NBA All-Star Game. However, it has not been selected to host the World Games yet.
 
• **Austin **is the capital city of Texas, known for its vibrant music scene, museums, and outdoor activities. It has hosted several major sporting events, including the Formula One United States Grand Prix and the X Games. However, it has not been selected to host the World Games yet.
 
• **Washington **is the capital city of the United States, known for its iconic landmarks, museums, and political institutions. It has hosted several major sporting events, including the Olympic Games in 1996 and the FIFA Women's World Cup in 1999. However, it has not been selected to host the World Games yet.
